apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: 9.0b — gamma. The crash-proofing release: two full sweeps, the weights bench taught to keep its footing — loads refused when headroom is short, generations that cancel under memory pressure and watch their own oxygen — and backdrop films decoded on a fixed budget. No invented errands: a second reading dispatches only on the operator's own words, and “don't forget” keeps what it is told. Haptics rebuilt so every beat lands. Her manners kept: no scaffolding, no speaker labels in her speech, and a why answered in her own voice.
